title: docs(spec): register the user-field deleteBehavior enforcement as an ADR-0087 semantic entry and correct the delete-walk prose, protocol describe included (#29415)
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzhJG3tKnksHVa1krBz _Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBTc1Gxk14k2PbeArtFLuL8a)_ Fixes #29415 Supersedes #29553 (same commits, resumed on a new branch; #29553 is closed) Clause-②: no Metadata-protocol: none ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么：在 #29553 的三个提交之上（从 `59709cbb` 续做，两次合入 main），补上冻结期间欠下的两处文字：对象元数据读取的 `cascadeDeleteObjects` 说明现在把「声明了 `deleteBehavior: 'cascade'` 的 user 字段」列入会级联删除的关系；`FieldSchema` 的 deleteBehavior 注释把容易误读的「AUTHORS one」改成「declares a `deleteBehavior`」。其余内容（语义迁移条目、hook/contract 文字、两个表单的可见性规则）与 #29553 相同。 - 为什么改：#29368 让 user 字段上声明的 deleteBehavior 在删除用户时生效，spec 文字还说 user 字段不参与删除联动；protocol.ts 冻结已解除（#28677 评论 6588593530），上一席的 Release 6591556737 点名这两处为落地前的欠项。 - 风险与回滚：只改文字和重新生成的参考文档，运行时与作者可写的键都不变。第二次合入 main 时 field.form.ts 与 #29639 新增的 `referenceNameVisible` 行相邻冲突，已手工合并、两边都保留。#29253 的未发布 changeset 仍是有意更正，`check-empty-changeset` 按设计保持红灯（与 #29553 相同）。回滚即 revert。 - 先看：packages/spec/src/data/field.form.ts（合并冲突的解决处：`referenceNameVisible` 行与其下的 `deleteBehavior` 行）；packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts（`GetMetaItemResponseSchema.cascadeDeleteObjects`）；.changeset/29415-user-delete-behavior-entry.md（新增的同版更正段）。 - 两分钟验证：`grep -c "or .user. field that declares" content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx`，预期输出 1（`cascadeDeleteObjects` 那一行）。 - 需要你做的：在本 PR 上确认对 #29253 未发布 changeset 的这次更正（check-empty-changeset 的人工确认路径，与 #29553 相同）。 ## What changes This PR carries the three commits of #29553 (`44bec0e9`, `21cd9672`, `59709cbb`) unchanged, merges `origin/main` twice (`744211fc`, then `1c1a5d40`), and adds the delta that the `protocol.ts` freeze held back. #29553's body describes the inherited part: the semantic entry `user-field-delete-behavior-enforced`, the correction of the unreleased #29253 changeset, the prose in `field.zod.ts`, `hook.zod.ts`, `objectql-engine.ts` and the `user-field-foreign-reference-refused` entry, and the `deleteBehavior` visibility rule in both forms. The delta: - **`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`, `GetMetaItemResponseSchema.cascadeDeleteObjects`.** The describe listed the cascading relations as "a `master_detail` by default, a `lookup` or `tree` that declares `deleteBehavior: 'cascade'`". It now reads "a `master_detail` by default, a `lookup`, `tree` or `user` field that declares `deleteBehavior: 'cascade'`", the wording of the `getCascadeDeleteObjects` contract docblock. The engine side already holds: `getCascadeDeleteObjects` walks `cascadeRelationBehavior`, whose family test is `statesDeleteSemantics`, which admits a `user` field that declares a `deleteBehavior` (`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`, on `744211fc`). - **The other three sites the order named, measured and left as they are.** `GetMetaItemCachedResponseSchema.cascadeDeleteObjects` points at "the item read's `cascadeDeleteObjects`" and lists no relation kinds; the two `[#28001]` docblocks (above `GetMetaItemResponseSchema` and `GetMetaItemCachedResponseSchema`) speak of "the rule its delete walk runs" and list none either. None of the three says or implies that a `user` field stays out of the walk, so none is edited. - **`packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`, the `deleteBehavior` docblock (#9784 paragraph).** "and on a `user` field that AUTHORS one" read as a `user` field authoring a `reference`, which the same schema refuses. It now reads "and on a `user` field that declares a `deleteBehavior`"; the rest of the parenthetical is re-wrapped, unchanged. - **Regenerated:** `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx` (1 row) and `content/docs/references/api/app-bundle.mdx` (5 rows), both by `gen:docs`. No other artifact moved (`check:generated`: all 14 up to date). - **Changeset** `.changeset/29415-user-delete-behavior-entry.md` stays a `@objectstack/spec` patch. Its spec-text bullet now names the `cascadeDeleteObjects` description on the metadata `object` read beside the other corrected texts. - **DELIBERATE CORRECTION of the unreleased #28001 note** (`.changeset/28001-cascade-delete-objects-beside-item.md`, patch round 1 at `abde58e1`, the contract review's should-fix 1): its one sentence listing the cascading relations now reads "a `lookup`, `tree` or `user` field that declares `deleteBehavior: 'cascade'`", word for word the corrected describe, so the note is true on the day it ships. `check-empty-changeset` reds on this file and on `.changeset/29253-user-field-delete-behavior.md`, both corrections by design. - **Maintainer authorization of the changeset corrections**, verbatim in the card thread, 2026-11-03T02:56Z: 「授权你修改」. ## Why Release 6591556737 on #29415 names exactly this delta as owed before landing; the freeze that held `protocol.zod.ts` was lifted at 6588593530 on #28677. Triage's at-tier record 6588315424 (PASS on `59709cbb`) covers the inherited commits; contract-review-hold 6588339023 covers the old head until this edit lands. ## Tests No test added: the delta is describe and comment text, and no reader parses it. Text only, so no accept set moves: `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.
pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test and typecheck, head 72a8bffd - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: Test Files 803 passed (803), Tests 23790 passed and 1 todo. - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: `tsc --noEmit`, `check:scripts-typecheck` and `check:test-typecheck` exit 0 (52 files / 240 errors / 131 pinned signatures held in the debt ledger, unchanged). - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/validate-predicate-path-refs.test.ts`: 62 passed (62), with main's predicate count 91 and this branch's literal-comparison count 63 side by side after the merge. - All three in one locked run: `VERDICT command-exit 0`. - The same spec suite on the pre-merge head `89540569` (before the second `origin/main` merge): Test Files 802 passed (802), Tests 23736 passed and 1 todo, typecheck exit 0.
## Verification
Build, generated artifacts and derived gates, head 72a8bffd - Two merges of `origin/main`: `83189767` (onto `744211fc`, clean) and `72a8bffd` (onto `1c1a5d40`). The second hit one conflict in `packages/spec/src/data/field.form.ts`: #29639 put its `referenceNameVisible` row directly above the `deleteBehavior` row this branch respells. Resolved by hand, keeping both: main's comment and row, and this branch's `data.type in ['lookup','user']` gate on `deleteBehavior`. `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh` ran after each merge. For `app-bundle.mdx`, `protocol.mdx` and `hook.mdx` it kept the branch's bytes, because main did not touch them. - Full build after the second merge (`turbo run build --filter=!@objectstack/docs --concurrency=2`, under the verify lock): 117/117 tasks, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. Then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: all 14 generated artifacts up to date. - Derived gates (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 105 commands on `72a8bffd`), run one after another with `CMD :: exit N` recorded: 104 exit 0, and 1 exits 1 by design, `check-empty-changeset --base origin/main` on `.changeset/29253-user-field-delete-behavior.md` (see Acceptance notes). `dispatch-gates --ran`: 105 derived, 105 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, exit 0. - No gate is left NOT MEASURED. The built-output gates (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:i18n`, `check:docs-transcript-drift`, `spec check:skill-examples`, `lint check:doc-formula-expressions`, `lint check:doc-security-posture`) ran on a full build and exit 0. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` was NOT MEASURED on #29553. - Local-only state gates: `pnpm check:dev-prereqs` and `pnpm check:skill-frame-freshness` exit 0.
## Acceptance notes - `check-empty-changeset` stays red by design, as on #29553: this PR rewrites the pending #29253 release note it did not add (the DELIBERATE CORRECTION class). The remedy is a confirmation on the PR, not a restore. - The `#7010 corpus` census pin in `packages/lint/src/validate-predicate-path-refs.test.ts` (63) is inherited from `59709cbb`. `origin/main` moved no `visibleWhen` or `data.type` predicate under `packages/spec/src` between the fork point `399df5bb` and `744211fc` (`git diff -G` over that range: zero files), so the count still holds. The test file passes on the final head (62/62). The second merge brought #29639's `referenceNameVisible` row, which is an in-list too: it moves main's predicate count to 91 and leaves the literal-comparison count at 63. - The inherited acceptance notes of #29553 stand (the `tree` control, the form's missing empty option, #29400). ## Human Minimum - [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. - [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. - [ ] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (No formatter ran. `pnpm lint` was not run locally: it is CI's run.) - [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request. - [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. - [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. - [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`. - [x] 8.
